positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "President Biden has unnecessarily spent trillions of dollars, spiking inflation into a 40-year high of 8.6 percent. As a result of this inflation, American households will pay an additional $7,620 as they buy gas, food, and other things over the next 12 months--$7,620 annually. Since Biden became President, real wages are down 4.2 percent while mortgage rates have doubled, have gone up 2.4 points. Our economy shrank 1.4 percent last quarter, and many economists now agree that these signs point to an imminent recession. The President now points to the Federal Reserve to get him out of the inflation mess that he created. Today, I will point out what that may mean and talk about the challenge that the Fed faces to rein in inflation."

"The Biden Administration is building us back bankrupt and rising costs are strangling hard-working families. Democrats’ spending and economic policies have led to rising prices at the pump and grocery stores. We know what works: limited government and lower taxes will ensure that families keep more of their hard-earned paychecks and make decisions that benefit their families."
Voted against H.R. 4521 "America COMPETES Act of 2022"
Voted against H.R. 7688 "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Our border needs to be secured. Putting off fully funding our border security will endanger the American people. I've made it clear Congress needs to support the wall -- and that's why I voted for this package today."

"The Biden administration continues to fail the American people by not securing our nation's southern border. The policies of the Biden administration have created the humanitarian and national security crisis we all are witnessing. Their refusal to secure our border is resulting in drug trafficking, particularly fentanyl, and human trafficking which impacts communities like ours across the country. This is the result of weak border policies."

"We need a strong leader in the White House to ensure our safety and security domestically and abroad. We need to project strength to avoid conflict. We must get operational control of the southern border and invest in a wall and technology to support our border patrol agents. I’ve seen it firsthand and spoken with border patrol agents about the challenges we face at the southern border. It is the largest entry point for human and drug trafficking, and the ripple effects jeopardize our safety in PA-11."
Voted in favor of HR 2 "Secure the Border Act of 2023"
